name: Yiwang  Xiongjian  - Forgotten Terror
source:
Moving into a close senior's home, but nightmares follow. Terrifying ghostly figures, a senior who seems to be hiding something. What secret lies behind the door that cannot be opened?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210670]Steam[/url]]
translation:
搬入关系亲近的学长家中，噩梦却接踵而至。骇人的鬼影、似乎有所隐瞒的学长——那扇始终无法打开的房门背后，究竟藏着怎样的秘密？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210670]Steam[/url]]
